title: Anna's Future Job
text:
Anna is seventeen years old and goes to a technical school. She studies computers and English every day. Her teacher says that English is very important for good jobs.

Anna wants to work in an office in another country. Next year she will take an English exam. If she passes it, she can apply for a job abroad.

questions.text: What will Anna do next year?
Why does Anna study English so hard?
options: Her teacher is angry with her
She wants a good job in another country

questions.text: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Languages can help a person's career

vocabulary.definition: having a big effect or value, so people must pay attention
a test of knowledge or skill
ask formally for a job or a place
in or to a foreign country

paragraph_translations: Anna ma siedemnaście lat i chodzi do technikum. Codziennie uczy się informatyki i angielskiego. Jej nauczycielka mówi, że angielski jest bardzo ważny dla dobrej pracy.
Anna chce pracować w biurze w innym kraju. W przyszłym roku zda egzamin z angielskiego. Jeśli go zda, będzie mogła ubiegać się o pracę za granicą.
